mapper.sql: id,CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.legacyId')) AS UNSIGNED) legacy_id, config_version,config_subtype,record_status,approval_status,scope_key,record_version,source_config_id, subject_user_id,secondary_user_id,effective_from,effective_to,created_at, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.storageReference')) storage_reference, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.positiveCount')) AS UNSIGNED) positive_count, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.negativeCount')) AS UNSIGNED) negative_count, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.boundaryCount')) AS UNSIGNED) boundary_count, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.piiApprovalReference')) pii_approval_reference, CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.reviewedBy')) AS UNSIGNED) reviewed_by, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.nerF1')) ner_f1, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.endToEndF1')) end_to_end_f1, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.highRiskRecall')) high_risk_recall, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.falseMaskingRate')) false_masking_rate, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.executionLogSha256')) execution_log_sha256, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.failureSummarySha256')) failure_summary_sha256, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.approvedAt')) approved_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_system_config(config_key,config_type, config_version,config_value,config_schema_version,lifecycle_status,approval_status,scope_key,config_subtype, subject_user_id,record_status,record_version,source_config_id,effective_from,effective_to,is_active,created_by) VALUES(CONCAT(#{row.configType},'_TMP:',UUID()),#{row.configType},#{row.configVersion}, CAST(#{row.configValueJson} AS JSON),CASE WHEN #{row.configType}='MASKING_RUN' THEN 'masking-run-v1' ELSE 'masking-dataset-v1' END, 'ACTIVE','PENDING',#{row.scopeKey},#{row.configSubtype},#{row.subjectUserId},#{row.recordStatus},#{row.recordVersion}, #{row.sourceConfigId},CASE WHEN #{row.configType}='MASKING_RUN' THEN NOW(3) ELSE NULL END,#{row.effectiveTo},0,#{row.createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_system_config SET config_key=CONCAT(#{prefix},id) WHERE id=#{id}

UPDATE t_system_config SET record_status='REVIEWED', config_value=JSON_SET(config_value,'$.reviewedBy',#{actor},'$.reviewedAt',NOW(3)),updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE config_type='MASKING_DATASET' AND config_version=#{version} AND record_status='REGISTERED' AND subject_user_id<>#{actor} AND effective_to>NOW(3)

UPDATE t_system_config SET record_status='APPROVED',approval_status='APPROVED', secondary_user_id=#{actor},config_value=JSON_SET(config_value,'$.approvedAt',NOW(3)),updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE config_type='MASKING_DATASET' AND config_version=#{version} AND record_status='REVIEWED' AND subject_user_id<>#{actor} AND CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(config_value,'$.reviewedBy')) AS UNSIGNED)<>#{actor} AND effective_to>NOW(3)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_system_config WHERE config_type='MASKING_DATASET' ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT FROM t_system_config WHERE config_type='MASKING_RELEASE' AND config_version=#{version} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM t_system_config WHERE config_type='MASKING_DATASET' AND config_version=#{version} AND effective_to>NOW(3)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_system_config WHERE config_type='MASKING_RUN' AND source_config_id=#{releaseId} AND record_version=#{datasetId} AND config_version=#{engineVersion}
SELECT FROM t_system_config WHERE config_type='MASKING_RUN' AND config_key=CONCAT('MASKING_RUN:',#{runId}) FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_system_config SET record_status='APPROVED',approval_status='APPROVED', secondary_user_id=#{actor},config_desc=#{reason},config_value=JSON_SET(config_value,'$.approvedAt',NOW(3)),updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND config_type='MASKING_RUN'

UPDATE t_system_config SET record_status='EVALUATED',record_version=#{runId}, config_value=JSON_SET(config_value,'$.evaluationAuditId',#{auditId},'$.evaluationApprovedBy',#{actor}),updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND config_type='MASKING_RELEASE' AND record_status='DRAFT'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_system_config WHERE config_type='MASKING_RUN' AND scope_key=#{version} ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_system_config SET record_status='EXPIRED',lifecycle_status='EXPIRED',is_active=0, updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE config_type='MASKING_DATASET' AND record_status IN ('REGISTERED','REVIEWED','APPROVED') AND effective_to<=NOW(3)
